rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when ideals, principles, or ideas are embodied in a law, system, or other form.

example.english: These new laws clearly embody the principle that everyone is equal.
example.traditional: 呢幾條新法例清楚體現人人平等嘅原則。
example.jyutping: ni1 gei2 tiu4 san1 faat3 lai6 cing1 co2 tai2 jin6 jan4 jan4 ping4 dang2 ge3 jyun4 zak1

rows.meaning: include as part of a whole
rows.note: Use this when something embodies something else by including it as one part of a larger whole.

example.english: This course aims to embody grammar, conversation, and writing practice.
example.traditional: 呢套課程包括文法、會話同埋寫作訓練。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 fo3 cing4 baau1 kut3 man4 faat3 wui6 waa2 tung4 maai4 se2 zok3 fan3 lin6

rows.traditional: A 係 B 嘅化身
rows.jyutping: A hai6 B ge3 faa3 san1
rows.note: Use this when a person or thing literally personifies or seems to be the incarnation of a quality B.

example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 zing3 ji6 ge3 faa3 san1
